sources.title: RTX 4090 24 GB Spec Breakdown for AI Workloads in 2026
sources.snippet: The RTX 4090 (Ada Lovelace, AD102 die) launched in 2022 and remained the consumer flagship until the RTX 5090 arrived in early 2025. For AI inference it's still relevant: 24 GB of GDDR6X, strong FP16 throughput, and now meaningfully cheaper than the Blackwell flagship. This page is the consolidated AI-buyer's reference.
